clips.title: The story
paras: Near Felwood, the Iron Shaft waits in a locked chest. It is one piece of Dartol's Rod, sought by Teronis to slow the furbolg assaults on Ashenvale.

Dartol made the rod, then its pieces were scattered across Ashenvale. One was placed in the care of the druids of Dor'Danil. The Iron Shaft is the rod's sturdy metal core, kept in a locked chest in a glade near Ashenvale's northern border, close to Felwood.
